instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Pulse operates in the rapidly evolving EdTech space, specializing in intensive technical bootcamps. We focus on high-demand skills like data science and cybersecurity tailored for immediate industry application. As a bootstrapped entity, our primary value proposition is rapid skill acquisition leading directly to placement.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.
answers.additionalContext: As a micro-company with limited capital, every strategic decision must prioritize high-leverage activities that minimize burn rate while actively pursuing market expansion to achieve diversification targets.

opportunities.title: Vertical Market Vertical Specialization & Licensing
opportunities.rationale: Given the low regulatory environment and existing technical expertise, Pulse can develop highly niche, verticalized training programs (e.g., specific compliance frameworks for FinTech or specialized AI model deployment). This radical shift allows us to move away from general bootcamp offerings which face high competition.

first_actions: Identify three underserved B2B niches requiring highly specific certification.
Pilot a 'Certified Specialist' program for the chosen niche over Q3.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 2 paying B2B contracts in the new vertical by end of Q4.

opportunities.title: Automated Content Curation Engine
opportunities.rationale: Invest in a low-code tool to automate the identification and updating of technical curriculum based on real-time job market demands. This incremental step improves training relevance without requiring a massive R&D team or budget.

first_actions: Evaluate existing LMS for automation hooks.
Allocate 10% of developer time to prototype the curation script.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in 'curriculum relevance' feedback score by 15 points.

opportunities.title: Affiliate Partnership Network Expansion
opportunities.rationale: Leverage the 'informal_conversations' feedback loop by establishing a structured affiliate program targeting complementary services (e.g., specialized SaaS tools). This provides new revenue streams without requiring us to build entirely new product lines.

first_actions: Develop a tiered commission structure for partners.
Pitch the program to 10 relevant industry influencers.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve $50k in affiliate-driven revenue by year-end.

next_steps.action: Form a small 'Diversification Task Force' focused solely on mapping three adjacent B2B markets for niche technical training.
Allocate dedicated development time to prototype the automated content curation engine using low-code tools.
Identify and onboard 5 potential affiliate partners in the cybersecurity or data science SaaS space.

key_weaknesses: Severe resource constraint leading to high context-switching costs for developers (no dedicated R&D role).
Fragmented and 'partial' innovation process lacking formal documentation or standardized scaling frameworks.
Over-reliance on informal customer feedback, making strategic pivot identification slow and inconsistent.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) limiting the ability to leverage large-scale AI/ML tools for rapid product diversification.
